description: This script automates stress testing of OpenSSL components by executing various test functions, capturing system metrics, and logging results. It includes functions for different cryptographic tests and orchestrates their execution with timing and resource monitoring.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a command multiple times in parallel, redirecting output to /dev/null.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp and script basename to the log file.

methods.name: stress_cipher_function
methods.description: Runs cipher list and bytes tests.

methods.name: stress_err_function
methods.description: Runs error and fatal error tests.

methods.name: stress_tls_function
methods.description: Runs DTLS and TLS protocol tests.

methods.name: stress_evp_function
methods.description: Runs EVP (envelope) tests with various data.

methods.name: execute_ui_test
methods.description: Executes UI stress test multiple times, capturing metrics.

methods.name: execute_bio_test
methods.description: Executes BIO stress test multiple times, capturing metrics.

methods.name: execute_dsa_test
methods.description: Executes DSA stress test multiple times, capturing metrics.

methods.name: execute_tls_test
methods.description: Executes TLS protocol stress test multiple times, capturing metrics.

methods.name: execute_cipher_test
methods.description: Executes cipher list and bytes tests, capturing metrics.

methods.name: execute_asn1_test
methods.description: Executes ASN.1 encoding/decoding tests, capturing metrics.

methods.name: execute_x509_test
methods.description: Executes X509 certificate tests, capturing metrics.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the test suite, orchestrates the execution of all tests with timing and resource monitoring.
